title: I'm Here!
source_credit: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 1 Lesson 3. Official human conversation audio and matching dialogue. WorldVoice is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I am in my new apartment! Great! I live with Marsha. We’re roommates.
dialogue.translation_ar: أنا في شقتي الجديدة! رائع! أعيش مع مارشا. نحن زميلتان في السكن.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I want to cook dinner. Oh! Hmmm. Is there a supermarket near here? Marsha knows. Marsha's work number is 555-8986.
dialogue.translation_ar: أريد إعداد العشاء. هل يوجد متجر قريب؟ مارشا تعرف. رقم عملها 555-8986.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hello.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Hello. Is this Marsha? It is Anna.
dialogue.translation_ar: مرحبًا. هل أنت مارشا؟ أنا آنا.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: I am sorry. You have the wrong number.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Oh. Is this 555-8986?

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: No. This is 555-8689.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Oh. Excuse me!

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Okay. 'Bye.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: One more time. 555-8986. Please be Marsha.
dialogue.translation_ar: مرة أخرى. 555-8986. آمل أن تكون مارشا.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Hello. This is Marsha.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Yes, Marsha. I want to cook dinner.
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم يا مارشا. أريد أن أعد العشاء.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Excuse me? Anna? Is that you?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Oh, yes. I am here!

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Good. You are there.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I want to find a supermarket.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Oh, okay. The supermarket is at 1500 Irving Street. It is near the apartment.
dialogue.translation_ar: حسنًا. المتجر في شارع إيرفينغ رقم 1500. إنه قرب الشقة.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Great! Goodbye!

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Goodbye, Anna.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: There is a big supermarket on our street. And Marsha says I am a good cook! Until next time! Bye!
dialogue.translation_ar: يوجد متجر كبير في شارعنا. ومارشا تقول إنني طاهية جيدة! إلى المرة القادمة، وداعًا!
